paper.title: DirectFisheye-GS: Enabling Native Fisheye Input in Gaussian Splatting with Cross-View Joint Optimization

claim: 作者定位：鱼眼镜头因超宽视场（>90°，常见 120° 或 180°）与少量采集即可高效覆盖场景，是自动驾驶、机器人与沉浸式 VR 的基石输入；但其严重径向畸变与非线性投影违反原始 3DGS 的针孔假设，直接套用会产生伪影与性能退化。

Fisheye lenses’ severe ra- dial distortion and nonlinear projection violate pinhole as- sumptions of the original 3DGS, causing artifacts and per- formance degradation when naively applied.

evidence.short_quote: We integrate the Kannala-Brandt [14] fisheye projection model into the 3DGS pipeline, eliminating the need for undistortion pre- processing and preserving the efficiency of rasterization- based rendering. This not only ensures full compatibility with existing 3DGS viewers and commercial tools, but also retains the original spatial relationships among neighbor- ing rays—an essential condition for multi-view consistency constraints.

to extreme shapes (e.g., oversized or elongated) that de- grade reconstruction quality.
